units.rawText: I always find strange objects during my routine cleaning of the dormitory.

units.rawText: Broken hairpins, envelopes covered in doodles, and tattered stuffed animals.

units.rawText: Those and... sometimes I find insects too... Master, are you feeling all right? Shall we change the topic?
